techs.Name: Patrol the Market

techs.Name: Exterminate Rats!

techs.Name: Mine Sweep

techs.Description: The rugged inhabitants of Byrgenwald Forest would be a great addition to Yensburg's workforce. Send out emissaries to proselytize to them and convince them of their new purpose.
techs.Name: Wilderness Evangelism

techs.Name: Decursing the Library

techs.Name: Shield of the Innocent

techs.Name: Bank "Heist"

techs.Description: The vast woods south of Yensburg have never been fully safe, but recently even travel over the Imperial Road has been fraught with danger. Drive off the wild creatures that threaten passage through the forest.
techs.Name: Byrgenwald Expedition

techs.Description: As refugees were driven westward towards Yensburg, they ended up in a refugee camp that has been set up in the city's slums. Send in a team that has experience in dealing with the disease and misery that reign there.

techs.Description: A fortified ring adorned with three small sapphires.
techs.Name: Ring of Protection

techs.Description: The unblinking eye that adorns this ring stares back at the wearer incessantly.
techs.Name: Band of the Cyclops

techs.Description: The living metal slithers around the wearer's finger as it sucks their blood for sustenance.
techs.Name: Serpentine Band

techs.Description: The elemental magic contained in this ring is constantly attempting to break free.
techs.Name: Monsoon Band

techs.Description: The ring constantly sheds tiny seeds that drift off on the wind and sprout alien flowers in the countryside.
techs.Name: Band of Tranquility

techs.Description: The hungry ring slowly binds itself to the wearer's soul until the two are inseperable.
techs.Name: Undying Band

techs.Description: The ring's magic slowly burrows into the wearer's skin, weaving impenetrable fibers into their very being.
techs.Name: Leaden Band

techs.Description: A brilliant red ruby pendant that invigorates the wearer.
techs.Name: Amulet of Vitality

techs.Description: Energizes the wearer and anyone in their vicinity.
techs.Name: Amulet of Vigor

techs.Description: Envelops the wearer and their allies in a protective shroud that wards off fire and extreme heat.
techs.Name: Amulet of Fire Protection

techs.Description: Projects an aura of death and hopelessness in an attempt to protect the wearer and their allies from dark magic.
techs.Name: Amulet of Dark Tidings

techs.Description: Creates a detoxifying aura that protects the wearer and their allies from even the most vile poisons.
techs.Name: Panacea Amulet

techs.Description: Exudes a gentle soothing aura that intermittently heals the wearer's allies for a small amount.
techs.Name: Lifebloom Amulet

techs.Description: The tiny beads on this necklace are, in fact, dangerous weapons: They spontaneously combust after being thrown.
techs.Name: Necklace of Fireballs

techs.Description: A talisman normally awarded to exceptionally gifted adventurers after a lifetime of service to the guild.
techs.Name: Medallion of Excellence

techs.Description: An ornate necklace of blessed gold and silver beads, intended to be used in ritualized prayer.
techs.Name: Prayer Beads

techs.Description: A place to safely store expensive jewelry and inventions for a small fee. All treasuries are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
techs.Name: Treasury

techs.Description: Summons forth extraplanar creatures to fight in your wars and serve as training fodder for your adventurers.
techs.Name: Summoning Circle

techs.Name: Mad Hermit

techs.Name: Witch Coven

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Summoning Circle.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#.
techs.Name: Army of Darkness

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Deepest Pits Of Hell

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Summoning Circle.
techs.Name: School of Summoning

techs.Description: A tiny but ferocious demon that can be used to help train your adventurers and fight your wars.
techs.Name: Summon Gremlin

techs.Description: A hulking demoning creature dredged up from the depths of the underworld.
techs.Name: Summon Hellspawn

techs.Description: An ominous floating creature that attacks enemies from afar using its chaotic eyebeams.
techs.Name: Summon Watcher

techs.Description: A small angelic creature empowered with healing magic.
techs.Name: Summon Cherub

techs.Description: A holy angelic warrior who smites her foes with divine fury.
techs.Name: Summon Valkyrie

techs.Description: The purest expression of divine punishment. None can escape his sword of wrath.
techs.Name: Summon Arbiter

techs.Description: A secret ritual known only to the hermit allows a warlock to train as a #Demonologist#.
techs.Name: Demonic Initiation

techs.Description: Prepares a wide variety of potions to support your adventurers in combat.
techs.Name: Alchemist

techs.Description: Unlocks the first #Upgrade slot# for your Alchemist.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically brew potions.
techs.Name: Autobrewery

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Alchemist.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
techs.Name: Cauldron Stirrers

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Alchemist.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#. Effect is #halved# for equippable items.
techs.Name: Distillation Column

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Extra Red Health Potion

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Alchemist.
techs.Name: Deranged Assistant

techs.Description: A natural cave formation buried deep within the Byrgenwald Forest. Some mysterious force inside twists the forest animals into monstrous abominations.
techs.Name: Feral Den

techs.Description: An alchemical reagent used in a wide variety of arcane processes.
techs.Name: Attuned Catalyst

techs.Description: Employs a secret alchemical catalyst to transmute common iron into precious metals.
techs.Name: Transmute Metals

techs.Description: A brilliant red potion that can instantly restore minor wounds.
techs.Name: Healing Potion

techs.Description: A pale yellow potion that instantly re-energizes even the most tired soul.
techs.Name: Revitalizing Potion

techs.Description: Your expert alchemist takes a good look at the plant samples collected by your adventurers and sorts them by type.
techs.Name: Identify Plants

techs.Description: A vial of swirling orange liquid. Looks like you're drinking liquid fire, but the taste is surprisingly pleasant.
techs.Name: Elixir of Fire Resistance

techs.Description: A dark purple brew. Trying to drink it evokes an almost primal fear in most people.
techs.Name: Elixir of Shadow Resistance

techs.Description: A sickly-green potion. Drinking it makes you gag at first, before that nagging headache miraculously disappears.
techs.Name: Elixir of Poison Resistance

techs.Description: A disgustingly bitter potion. Shortly after consumption, the drinker feels impervious to harm.
techs.Name: Stoneskin Elixir

techs.Description: A brilliant red potion that can instantly restore grievous wounds.
techs.Name: Greater Healing Potion

techs.Description: After drinking this concoction the user feels ever so slightly more proficient at anything they do.
techs.Name: Elixir of Mastery

techs.Description: A highly concentrated emerald liquid. It hones the drinker's quick wit and reflexes, making rapid actions easier to execute.
techs.Name: Elixir of Alacrity

techs.Description: The thick liquid burns on the way down, in a pleasant way. The drinker feels continuously reinvigorated, an effect that can last for days.
techs.Name: Elixir of Regeneration

techs.Description: Organize fights of man versus man or man versus monster. Earn big money for spectacular battles and train your adventurers at the same time.
techs.Name: Arena

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Arenas.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically start arena fights.
techs.Name: Fight Announcer

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Arena.
techs.Name: Hypogeum

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Arena.
techs.Name: Gladiator School

techs.Description: Unlocks a new #Upgrade# for your Arena.\n\nIncreases gold income from arena fights by #10%#.
techs.Name: Fight Purse

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Blood Sport# upgrade: Combatants fight until only one is left standing. Training received is increased massively, especially in human-versus-human fights, and spectators pay more for a bloody finale.
techs.Name: Fight To The Death

techs.Description: A hidden force has struck at the heart of Yensburg. Some districts have fallen under enemy control, and the tunnels beneath the city are crawling with demonic foes.
techs.Name: War: Hidden Enemies

techs.Description: Ages ago, a profane ritual was carried out here to imprison an ancient evil. Now, sinister forces are working to undo the ritual's magic.
techs.Name: Temple of the Last Rite

techs.Description: A place to store loot collected from dungeons and quests. No storage fee. All hoards are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
techs.Name: Hoard

techs.Description: The kingdom's Chief High Artificer is renowned for creating exciting new technology (side effects not guaranteed).
techs.Name: Inventor

techs.Description: Unlocks the first #Upgrade slot# for your Inventor.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically create inventions.
techs.Name: Automaton

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Inventor.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
techs.Name: Eureka!

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Inventor.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#. Effect is #halved# for equippable items.
techs.Name: Edison

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Da Vinci

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Inventor.
techs.Name: Widgets?

techs.Name: Tinker

techs.Name: Widget

techs.Name: Gizmo

techs.Description: A wondrous biochemical concoction.

techs.Description: In search of new breakthroughs in mechanical science.
techs.Name: Mechanical Experimentation

techs.Description: In search of new breakthroughs in alchemical knowledge.
techs.Name: Alchemical Experimentation

techs.Description: In search of new breakthroughs in biological studies.
techs.Name: Biological Experimentation

techs.Description: A wondrous innovation in magical technology.
techs.Name: Tinkersteel

techs.Description: A stupendous advancement in magical technology.
techs.Name: Witchcloth

techs.Description: An innovative tradition in magical technology.
techs.Name: Primal Leather

techs.Description: A revolutionary new way to incorporate cutting edge mago-tech into traditional craftsmanship.
techs.Name: Petrified Wood

techs.Description: A wondrous invention that allows the wearer to fly over short distances, making feats of dexterity more manageable.
techs.Name: Winged Boots

techs.Description: Enhances the wearer's natural strength, allowing them to lift heavy boulders with ease.
techs.Name: Golem Gauntlets

techs.Description: Allows the wearer to detect and identify subtle magical influences embedded in the environment.
techs.Name: Leyline Goggles

techs.Description: Automatically highlights the target's weakspots for the wearer.\n\nA character can only benefit from a single source of Critical Hit.
techs.Name: Assassin's Goggles

techs.Description: A wondrous invention driven by a mago-tech engine. Its sharp teeth cut into anything it comes into contact with, so be careful what you point it at.
techs.Name: Chainsaw

techs.Description: A clockwork arm that straps to the wearer's back, holding a small round shield. Its rudimentary mago-tech brain predicts and blocks incoming enemy attacks.
techs.Name: Puppet Shield

techs.Description: A portable anti-magic shield that protects the wearer from Fire, Shadow and Poison damage all at the same time.
techs.Name: Triune Protector

techs.Description: The pinnacle of mago-tech engineering, designed to extract the living energy of a dreaming God.
techs.Name: Nightmare Collector

techs.Description: Allows you to exchange one currency for another, for a price.\n\n#Click# a currency in the top bar to start a transaction.
techs.Name: Currency Exchange

techs.Description: Reduces Currency Exchange tax by #50%#.
techs.Name: Market Maker

techs.Description: Writes a variety of books and scrolls imbued with magical energy or spiritual significance.
techs.Name: Scribe

techs.Description: Unlocks the first #Upgrade slot# for your Scribe.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically write scrolls and tomes.
techs.Name: Enchanted Quill

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Scribe.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
techs.Name: Scriptorium

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Scribe.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#. Effect is #halved# for equippable items.
techs.Name: Printing Press

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Illumination

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Scribe.
techs.Name: Monastic Labor

techs.Description: A traditional writing surface made from the skin of certain animals. Its inherent magical qualities make it very useful for writing prepared spells and arcane treatises.
techs.Name: Blank Vellum

techs.Description: Pristine blank pages, ready to be filled with arcane incantations or prophetic writings.
techs.Name: Blank Tome

techs.Description: In a flash of deranged genius, one of your Mages can sketch out the designs for a novel mago-tech contraption.
techs.Name: Mad Scribblings

techs.Description: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a large amount of health.
techs.Name: Scroll of Healing

techs.Description: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a small amount of health to all party members.
techs.Name: Scroll of Radiance

techs.Description: This scroll's magic can be repeatedly evoked to deal heavy damage to powerful foes.
techs.Name: Scroll of Disintegration

techs.Description: Even just holding it makes you feel revitalized. Reading the scroll will restore energy to the entire party.
techs.Name: Scroll of Second Wind

techs.Description: Contains a variety of medicinal recipes and practical tips for the aspiring doctor. Medical education not required.
techs.Name: Apothecary's Tome

techs.Description: Describes a hundred daily habits to improve the reader's life in almost every way possible.
techs.Name: Manual of Self-Improvement

techs.Description: A collection of honorable legends and inspiring anecdotes. Will encourage even the most melancholic serf.
techs.Name: Libram of Awakening

techs.Description: Learning from the ancient masters of biology allows a ranger to train as a #Survivalist#.
techs.Name: Study on Phytotoxins

techs.Description: A long-forgotten treatise on starting fires allows an elementalist to train as a #Pyromancer#.
techs.Name: Pyromancy and You: An Introduction

techs.Description: A back-to-basics apprenticeship allows an elementalist to train as a #Lithomancer#.
techs.Name: Rock Carving for Dummies

techs.Description: After many attempts, the infernal runes have been translated into a form that mortal humans can comprehend.
techs.Name: Decoded Writings

techs.Description: The incessant clicking of gears has been replaced with maddening whispers.
techs.Name: Demonsteel Helm

techs.Description: Blood drips continuously from tiny holes in the armor's surface with no indication of where it's coming from.
techs.Name: Demonsteel Armor

techs.Description: The demonic creature trapped inside the shield threatens to curse anyone that dares to strike it.
techs.Name: Possessed Shield

techs.Description: The mask slowly grows over the wearer's face, replacing their human features with a horrifying demonic visage.
techs.Name: Malignant Mask

techs.Description: Tiny needles hook into the wearer's flesh, causing immense discomfort but somehow also making almost any movement more graceful and deadly.
techs.Name: Malignant Cover

techs.Description: The kind of headwear that draws attention at a conference of mages. Subtle thought manipulation makes the wearer more adept at magic.
techs.Name: Archmage's Hat

techs.Description: Stylish and gaudy, this magnificent robe is sure to awe anyone that sees you wearing it. No harm ever came from trying on some clothes, right?
techs.Name: Archmage's Robe

techs.Description: The wearer is tormented by myriad voices screaming blasphemous prophecies into their ears.
techs.Name: Dark Prophet's Hood

techs.Description: A beguiling aura draws the attention of allies and foes alike, turning even the most hardened skeptic into a devout follower.
techs.Name: Dark Prophet's Robe

techs.Description: A safe repository for your valuable scrolls and tomes. All libraries are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
techs.Name: Library

techs.Description: Serves as a place of worship for your Clerics. Their devotion can be converted into powerful blessings.
techs.Name: Shrine

techs.Description: Unlocks the first #Upgrade slot# for your Shrine.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automate blessings and prayers.
techs.Name: Prayer Wheel

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Shrine.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
techs.Name: Shrine Maiden

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Shrine.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#. Productivity does not affect item enhancements.
techs.Name: Drive-through Prayer

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Relic of Saint Ilonia

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Shrine.
techs.Name: Devoted Clergy

techs.Description: A cleric offers a devout prayer to Saint Ilonia, generating a small amount of faith for your Kingdom.
techs.Name: Simple Prayer

techs.Description: Having been blessed by a miracle of Saint Ilonia, clerics from all walks of life would be honored to own these beads.
techs.Name: Blessed Prayer Beads

techs.Description: A more powerful prayer that would be more likely to garner Saint Ilonia's favor.
techs.Name: Ritual Prayer

techs.Description: A document issued by the divine bureaucracy that promises to erase the bearer's sins upon death.
techs.Name: Indulgence

techs.Description: Extends a holy blessing over any weapon, increasing its Quality.
techs.Name: Blessed Armaments

techs.Description: Extends a holy blessing over any non-weapon piece of equipment, increasing its Quality.
techs.Name: Sanctified Equipment

techs.Description: A coveted signet ring that signifies the wearer's high standing in the Church of Saint Ilonia.
techs.Name: Pontiff's Ring

techs.Description: The bones of a fallen hero, carefully preserved in a gilded wooden locket. Bestows divine protection upon the bearer.
techs.Name: Relic of the Martyr

techs.Description: A sacred ritual to train a guardian into a #Paladin#.
techs.Name: Guardian's Pledge

techs.Description: Conversing with the spirits of the natural world allows a ritualist to train as a #Shaman#.
techs.Name: Commune with Nature

techs.Description: Powerful oration to the gathered followers allows a priest to train as an #Evangelist#.
techs.Name: Preaching to the Choir

techs.Description: Memorizing the entire thousand-page prayer allows a priest to train as a #Lightbringer#.
techs.Name: Prayer of Light

techs.Description: The clerics at the Cathedral of Saint Ilonia swear that the heretical influence has been purged from this powerful arcane technology.
techs.Name: Purified Mago-tech

techs.Description: Dark matter particles drift off its edge and embed themselves into the wounds of its victims, inflicting more suffering over time.
techs.Name: Vanquisher's Sword

techs.Description: A system of hollow tubes constantly delivers a deadly mixture of flesh-devouring toxins to the tip of the blade.
techs.Name: Blighted Dagger

techs.Description: The thin blade of this sword is only connected to the hilt in some unseen dimension, allowing the point to bypass armor with ease.
techs.Name: Ethereal Rapier

techs.Description: A blade from the deepest pits of hell. It subtly encourages the wielder to commit horrible atrocities.
techs.Name: Flenser's Sword

techs.Description: The malignant growth overtaking this axe has manifested as a giant, unblinking eye, staring at its enemies with unrestrained fury.
techs.Name: Cyclopean Battleaxe

techs.Description: Demonic flesh bursts forth and covers the shooter's hand, correcting their aim and infecting their arrows with hellish rot.
techs.Name: Deadeye Bow

techs.Description: Unable to contain its frightening power, the staff fractured into shards that are still bound together by some unseen force.
techs.Name: Splintered Staff

techs.Description: A mockery of the natural world. Demonic vines shoot out to entrap the wielder's foes, forcing them to bow in submission.
techs.Name: Unlife Staff

techs.Description: The toxic negative energy has been purified by the grace of Saint Ilonia. By Her grace, it can be put to a better use.
techs.Name: Cleansed Nightmare

techs.Description: The labyrinthine tunnels beneath Yensburg Castle are still crawling with demonic entities. Send your adventurers down to clear them out and discover their origin.
techs.Name: Yensburg Catacombs

techs.Description: Ironcrag has been revealed as our enemy's stronghold. Lay siege to the mountain and clear a path for your adventurers to enter.
techs.Name: War: Ironcrag Siege

techs.Description: An ancient lich lord has been building an archive of human history in this hidden mountain fortress for centuries. Break through the defenses, slay the mad Archivist, and recover powerful items to aid in your battle.
techs.Name: Timeless Archive

techs.Description: Deep beneath the mountain, an ancient evil waits dreaming.
techs.Name: Tomb of Sholrath

techs.Description: Allows you collect more Distilled Nightmare prestige currency. Requires a steady supply of Nightmare Collectors.
techs.Name: Nightmare Distiller

techs.Description: Allows you to collect the remains of those who died fighting in your wars, and give them their eternal rest.
techs.Name: Graveyard

techs.Description: Adds a new output to all War Effort nodes. Here, the remains of slain combatants are available to be transferred to a Graveyard (but will not block the War Effort if left unconnected).
techs.Name: Fallen Heroes

techs.Description: A clean, no-frills way to lay your dead to rest.
techs.Name: Simple Burial

techs.Description: Send a Cleric to lead the mourners in solemn prayer. Generates additional Faith based on the cleric's Wisdom.
techs.Name: Officiated Burial

techs.Description: A highly ornate funeral for only the most decorated of war heroes. Generates additional Faith based on the cleric's Wisdom.
techs.Name: State Funeral

techs.Description: Unlocks the first #Upgrade slot# for your Graveyard.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically bury the dead.
techs.Name: Gravedigger

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Graveyard.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
techs.Name: Animated Shovels

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Graveyard.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#. Effect is #halved# for equippable items.
techs.Name: Mass Grave

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Royal Burial

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Graveyard.

techs.Description: A shady figure who will "appropriate" corpses from a conveniently situated graveyard for their sinister experiments.
techs.Name: Necromancer

techs.Description: Unlocks the first #Upgrade slot# for your Necromancer.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically awaken the dead.
techs.Name: Novice Necromancer

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Necromancer.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
techs.Name: Undead Helpers

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your Necromancer.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #10%#.
techs.Name: Vivisection

techs.Description: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
techs.Name: Decay Ward

techs.Description: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Necromancer.
techs.Name: Cult of the Damned

techs.Description: A simple undead creature that even a rookie necromancer could reanimate.
techs.Name: Undead Shambler

techs.Description: A skeletal minion, its tendons reinforced to be able to draw back the bow made out of its own ribs.
techs.Name: Skeletal Archer

techs.Description: With a skeletal structure reinforced by magical metal, this warrior fearlessly rushes into battle.
techs.Name: Skeletal Berserker

techs.Description: A cunning undead sorcerer capable of raining hellfire upon your enemies.
techs.Name: Skeletal Archmage

techs.Description: A fearsome undead monster, composed of several corpses stitched together into a single brute.
techs.Name: Hulking Monstrosity

techs.Description: A few practical lessons in raising the dead allows a warlock to train as a #Necromancer#.
techs.Name: Introduction to Necromancy

techs.Name: Better Zoom

techs.Name: Container Colors

techs.Description: Unlock the Spawner. Choose any item with its + button and see its gold value.
techs.Name: DevSpawner

techs.Description: Unlock ten custom building shortcuts and a vertical building hotbar. Configure them in Options > Mod Settings > Hotkey Customizer. Free research.
techs.Name: Hotkey Customizer

techs.Name: Ledger

Link named leylines across tabs.
Uses Portal's Mana transfer cost.
techs.Name: Leyline Conduits

techs.Name: Branching logic

techs.Description: Unlock timers and nonblocking delay circuits.
techs.Name: Logic timing

techs.Description: Unlock production rate, capacity, inventory, and telemetry measurements.
techs.Name: Workshop measurements

techs.Description: Unlock constants, counters, edge detectors, and reset sinks.
techs.Name: Controller memory & constants

techs.Description: Assemble up to 5 adventurers. Press Send now to release.
techs.Name: Party Node

techs.Description: Unlocks a Party Node upgrade slot. Use the node's + slot to buy Auto Send, which sends only complete selected lineups. Remove the upgrade to return to manual sending.
techs.Name: Auto Send

techs.Description: Reveal a node's immediate input and output paths in bright neon colors. Pin a node to keep its paths highlighted.
techs.Name: Path Finder

techs.Description: Unlock six input/output side layouts. Shift + Alt + left-click cycles layouts; Alt + left-click reverses the selected pair. Expandable-slot buildings keep their native ports.
techs.Name: Port Rotation

techs.Description: Unlock three extra snap positions between every original grid interval for nodes, pipe bends and decorations. Free research.
techs.Name: Snappy

elements.Description: Only allows items to pass through if your currency stockpile meets the set requirements.
elements.Name: Accountant

elements.Description: A globally renowned company that provides the adventurous customer with basic adventuring goods.
elements.Name: Adventure Supplies

elements.Description: Allows you to recruit rookie adventurers, ready for training and questing.
elements.Name: Adventurer's Guild

elements.Description: Prepares a wide variety of potions to support your adventurers in combat.
elements.Name: Alchemist

elements.Description: Sorts incoming items and humans by their stats and characteristics.
elements.Name: Appraiser

elements.Description: Organize fights of man versus man or man versus monster. Earn big money for spectacular battles and train your adventurers at the same time.
elements.Name: Arena

elements.Name: Armory

elements.Name: Barracks

elements.Name: Blacksmith

elements.Name: Butcher

elements.Name: Campfire

elements.Description: Crafts wooden weapons and intermediate components.
elements.Name: Carpenter

elements.Name: Collector

elements.Description: Native building type

elements.Description: Native building type

elements.Name: Disenchanter

elements.Name: Distributor

elements.Name: Dungeon

items.Name: Puppet Shield

items.Name: Triune Protector

items.Description: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a small amount of health to all party members.

items.Name: Apothecary's Tome

items.Description: Describes a hundred daily habits to improve the reader's life in almost every way possible.

items.Description: An ornate necklace of blessed gold and silver beads, intended to be used in ritualized prayer.
items.Name: Prayer Beads

items.Description: A sturdy wooden box designed to hold the dead body of a human.
items.Name: Coffin

items.Description: A wooden coffin decorated with a copious amount of gold, destined to hold the remains of someone important.
items.Name: Gilded Coffin

items.Description: The remains of someone who died in battle protecting your kingdom.

items.Description: A quiet gravesite in one of Yensburg's graveyards.

items.Description: After many attempts, the infernal runes have been translated into a form that mortal humans can comprehend.

items.Description: The incessant clicking of gears has been replaced with maddening whispers.

items.Description: The demonic creature trapped inside the shield threatens to curse anyone that dares to strike it.

items.Description: Tiny needles hook into the wearer's flesh, causing immense discomfort but somehow also making almost any movement more graceful and deadly.

items.Description: The mask slowly grows over the wearer's face, replacing their human features with a horrifying demonic visage.

items.Description: The wearer is tormented by myriad voices screaming blasphemous prophecies into their ears.

items.Description: A small angelic creature empowered with healing magic.

items.Description: A holy angelic warrior who smites her foes with divine fury.
items.Name: Valkyrie

items.Name: Arbiter

items.Name: Pontiff's Ring

items.Name: Fragmented Nightmare

items.Description: A reconstituted essence of pure darkness.

items.Description: The toxic negative energy has been purified by the grace of Saint Ilonia. By Her grace, it can be put to a better use.
items.Name: Cleansed Nightmare

items.Description: A hideously complex mago-tech invention, designed to constrain and direct the concentrated power of nightmare.
items.Name: Nightmare Casing

items.Description: The pinnacle of mago-tech engineering, designed to extract the living energy of a dreaming God.
items.Name: Nightmare Collector

recipes.Name: Transmute Metals

recipes.Description: A brilliant red potion that can instantly restore minor wounds.
recipes.Name: Healing Potion

recipes.Description: A pale yellow potion that instantly re-energizes even the most tired soul.
recipes.Name: Revitalizing Potion

recipes.Description: Your expert alchemist takes a good look at the plant samples collected by your adventurers and sorts them by type.
recipes.Name: Identify Plants

recipes.Description: A vial of swirling orange liquid. Looks like you're drinking liquid fire, but the taste is surprisingly pleasant.
recipes.Name: Elixir of Fire Resistance

recipes.Description: A dark purple brew. Trying to drink it evokes an almost primal fear in most people.
recipes.Name: Elixir of Shadow Resistance

recipes.Description: A sickly-green potion. Drinking it makes you gag at first, before that nagging headache miraculously disappears.
recipes.Name: Elixir of Poison Resistance

recipes.Description: A disgustingly bitter potion. Shortly after consumption, the drinker feels impervious to harm.
recipes.Name: Stoneskin Elixir

recipes.Description: A brilliant red potion that can instantly restore grievous wounds.
recipes.Name: Greater Healing Potion

recipes.Description: After drinking this concoction the user feels ever so slightly more proficient at anything they do.
recipes.Name: Elixir of Mastery

recipes.Description: A highly concentrated emerald liquid. It hones the drinker's quick wit and reflexes, making rapid actions easier to execute.
recipes.Name: Elixir of Alacrity

recipes.Description: The thick liquid burns on the way down, in a pleasant way. The drinker feels continuously reinvigorated, an effect that can last for days.
recipes.Name: Elixir of Regeneration

recipes.Description: Experiment with a variety of base components to create all-new inventions and generate Ingenuity.
recipes.Name: Tinker

recipes.Description: A curious mechanical invention.
recipes.Name: Widget

recipes.Description: A strange mago-technical innovation.
recipes.Name: Gizmo

recipes.Description: A wondrous biochemical concoction.
recipes.Name: Doodad

recipes.Description: In search of new breakthroughs in mechanical science.
recipes.Name: Mechanical Experimentation

recipes.Description: In search of new breakthroughs in alchemical knowledge.
recipes.Name: Alchemical Experimentation

recipes.Description: In search of new breakthroughs in biological studies.
recipes.Name: Biological Experimentation

recipes.Description: A wondrous innovation in magical technology.
recipes.Name: Tinkersteel

recipes.Description: A stupendous advancement in magical technology.
recipes.Name: Witchcloth

recipes.Description: An innovative tradition in magical technology.
recipes.Name: Primal Leather

recipes.Description: A revolutionary new way to incorporate cutting edge mago-tech into traditional craftsmanship.
recipes.Name: Petrified Wood

recipes.Description: A wondrous invention that allows the wearer to fly over short distances, making feats of dexterity more manageable.
recipes.Name: Winged Boots

recipes.Description: Enhances the wearer's natural strength, allowing them to lift heavy boulders with ease.
recipes.Name: Golem Gauntlets

recipes.Description: Allows the wearer to detect and identify subtle magical influences embedded in the environment.
recipes.Name: Leyline Goggles

recipes.Description: Automatically highlights the target's weakspots for the wearer.\n\nA character can only benefit from a single source of Critical Hit.
recipes.Name: Assassin's Goggles

recipes.Description: A wondrous invention driven by a mago-tech engine. Its sharp teeth cut into anything it comes into contact with, so be careful what you point it at.
recipes.Name: Chainsaw

recipes.Description: A clockwork arm that straps to the wearer's back, holding a small round shield. Its rudimentary mago-tech brain predicts and blocks incoming enemy attacks.
recipes.Name: Puppet Shield

recipes.Description: A portable anti-magic shield that protects the wearer from Fire, Shadow and Poison damage all at the same time.
recipes.Name: Triune Protector

recipes.Description: The pinnacle of mago-tech engineering, designed to extract the living energy of a dreaming God.
recipes.Name: Nightmare Collector

recipes.Description: A traditional writing surface made from the skin of certain animals. Its inherent magical qualities make it very useful for writing prepared spells and arcane treatises.
recipes.Name: Blank Vellum

recipes.Description: Pristine blank pages, ready to be filled with arcane incantations or prophetic writings.
recipes.Name: Blank Tome

recipes.Description: In a flash of deranged genius, one of your Mages can sketch out the designs for a novel mago-tech contraption.
recipes.Name: Mad Scribblings

recipes.Description: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a large amount of health.
recipes.Name: Scroll of Healing

recipes.Description: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a small amount of health to all party members.
recipes.Name: Scroll of Radiance

recipes.Description: This scroll's magic can be repeatedly evoked to deal heavy damage to powerful foes.
recipes.Name: Scroll of Disintegration

recipes.Description: Even just holding it makes you feel revitalized. Reading the scroll will restore energy to the entire party.
recipes.Name: Scroll of Second Wind

recipes.Description: Contains a variety of medicinal recipes and practical tips for the aspiring doctor. Medical education not required.
recipes.Name: Apothecary's Tome

recipes.Description: Describes a hundred daily habits to improve the reader's life in almost every way possible.
recipes.Name: Manual of Self-Improvement

recipes.Description: A collection of honorable legends and inspiring anecdotes. Will encourage even the most melancholic serf.
recipes.Name: Libram of Awakening

recipes.Description: Learning from the ancient masters of biology allows a ranger to train as a #Survivalist#.
recipes.Name: Study on Phytotoxins

recipes.Description: A long-forgotten treatise on starting fires allows an elementalist to train as a #Pyromancer#.
recipes.Name: Pyromancy and You: An Introduction

recipes.Description: A back-to-basics apprenticeship allows an elementalist to train as a #Lithomancer#.
recipes.Name: Rock Carving for Dummies

recipes.Description: After many attempts, the infernal runes have been translated into a form that mortal humans can comprehend.
recipes.Name: Decoded Writings

recipes.Description: The incessant clicking of gears has been replaced with maddening whispers.
recipes.Name: Demonsteel Helm

recipes.Description: Blood drips continuously from tiny holes in the armor's surface with no indication of where it's coming from.
recipes.Name: Demonsteel Armor

recipes.Description: The demonic creature trapped inside the shield threatens to curse anyone that dares to strike it.
recipes.Name: Possessed Shield

recipes.Description: The mask slowly grows over the wearer's face, replacing their human features with a horrifying demonic visage.
recipes.Name: Malignant Mask

recipes.Description: Tiny needles hook into the wearer's flesh, causing immense discomfort but somehow also making almost any movement more graceful and deadly.
recipes.Name: Malignant Cover

recipes.Description: The kind of headwear that draws attention at a conference of mages. Subtle thought manipulation makes the wearer more adept at magic.
recipes.Name: Archmage's Hat

recipes.Description: Stylish and gaudy, this magnificent robe is sure to awe anyone that sees you wearing it. No harm ever came from trying on some clothes, right?
recipes.Name: Archmage's Robe

recipes.Description: The wearer is tormented by myriad voices screaming blasphemous prophecies into their ears.
recipes.Name: Dark Prophet's Hood

recipes.Description: A beguiling aura draws the attention of allies and foes alike, turning even the most hardened skeptic into a devout follower.
recipes.Name: Dark Prophet's Robe

recipes.Description: A cleric offers a devout prayer to Saint Ilonia, generating a small amount of faith for your Kingdom.
recipes.Name: Simple Prayer

recipes.Description: Having been blessed by a miracle of Saint Ilonia, clerics from all walks of life would be honored to own these beads.
recipes.Name: Blessed Prayer Beads

recipes.Description: A more powerful prayer that would be more likely to garner Saint Ilonia's favor.
recipes.Name: Ritual Prayer

recipes.Description: A document issued by the divine bureaucracy that promises to erase the bearer's sins upon death.
recipes.Name: Indulgence

recipes.Description: Extends a holy blessing over any weapon, increasing its Quality.
recipes.Name: Blessed Armaments

recipes.Description: Extends a holy blessing over any non-weapon piece of equipment, increasing its Quality.
recipes.Name: Sanctified Equipment

recipes.Description: A coveted signet ring that signifies the wearer's high standing in the Church of Saint Ilonia.
recipes.Name: Pontiff's Ring

recipes.Description: The bones of a fallen hero, carefully preserved in a gilded wooden locket. Bestows divine protection upon the bearer.
recipes.Name: Relic of the Martyr

recipes.Description: A sacred ritual to train a guardian into a #Paladin#.
recipes.Name: Guardian's Pledge

recipes.Description: Conversing with the spirits of the natural world allows a ritualist to train as a #Shaman#.
recipes.Name: Commune with Nature

recipes.Description: Powerful oration to the gathered followers allows a priest to train as an #Evangelist#.
recipes.Name: Preaching to the Choir

recipes.Description: Memorizing the entire thousand-page prayer allows a priest to train as a #Lightbringer#.
recipes.Name: Prayer of Light

recipes.Description: The clerics at the Cathedral of Saint Ilonia swear that the heretical influence has been purged from this powerful arcane technology.
recipes.Name: Purified Mago-tech

recipes.Description: Dark matter particles drift off its edge and embed themselves into the wounds of its victims, inflicting more suffering over time.
recipes.Name: Vanquisher's Sword

recipes.Description: A system of hollow tubes constantly delivers a deadly mixture of flesh-devouring toxins to the tip of the blade.
recipes.Name: Blighted Dagger

recipes.Description: The thin blade of this sword is only connected to the hilt in some unseen dimension, allowing the point to bypass armor with ease.
recipes.Name: Ethereal Rapier

recipes.Description: A blade from the deepest pits of hell. It subtly encourages the wielder to commit horrible atrocities.
recipes.Name: Flenser's Sword

recipes.Description: The malignant growth overtaking this axe has manifested as a giant, unblinking eye, staring at its enemies with unrestrained fury.
recipes.Name: Cyclopean Battleaxe

recipes.Description: Demonic flesh bursts forth and covers the shooter's hand, correcting their aim and infecting their arrows with hellish rot.
recipes.Name: Deadeye Bow

recipes.Description: Unable to contain its frightening power, the staff fractured into shards that are still bound together by some unseen force.
recipes.Name: Splintered Staff

recipes.Description: A mockery of the natural world. Demonic vines shoot out to entrap the wielder's foes, forcing them to bow in submission.
recipes.Name: Unlife Staff

recipes.Description: The toxic negative energy has been purified by the grace of Saint Ilonia. By Her grace, it can be put to a better use.
recipes.Name: Cleansed Nightmare

recipes.Description: A clean, no-frills way to lay your dead to rest.
recipes.Name: Simple Burial

recipes.Description: Send a Cleric to lead the mourners in solemn prayer. Generates additional Faith based on the cleric's Wisdom.
recipes.Name: Officiated Burial

recipes.Description: A highly ornate funeral for only the most decorated of war heroes. Generates additional Faith based on the cleric's Wisdom.
recipes.Name: State Funeral

recipes.Description: A simple undead creature that even a rookie necromancer could reanimate.
recipes.Name: Undead Shambler

recipes.Description: A skeletal minion, its tendons reinforced to be able to draw back the bow made out of its own ribs.
recipes.Name: Skeletal Archer

recipes.Description: With a skeletal structure reinforced by magical metal, this warrior fearlessly rushes into battle.
recipes.Name: Skeletal Berserker

recipes.Description: A cunning undead sorcerer capable of raining hellfire upon your enemies.
recipes.Name: Skeletal Archmage

recipes.Description: A fearsome undead monster, composed of several corpses stitched together into a single brute.
recipes.Name: Hulking Monstrosity

recipes.Description: A few practical lessons in raising the dead allows a warlock to train as a #Necromancer#.
recipes.Name: Introduction to Necromancy

quests.Description: The market square in Yensburg is visited by thousands every week - and crime is rife. Help out the city guard by patrolling the market for pickpockets and other petty criminals.
quests.Name: Patrol the Market

quests.Description: Enormous invasive rats have been spotted in the harbor, possibly introduced from overseas. Several people have been found dead, gnawed to the bone. Exterminate the rats before they can establish a foothold!
quests.Name: Exterminate Rats!

quests.Description: The Grand Library of Yensburg has been overtaken by enchanted books. Dispel the ancient magic that animates the books and reclaim access to the library.
quests.Name: Decursing the Library

quests.Description: The network of mine tunnels that supply most of Yensburg's raw iron ore have been overrun by kobolds, causing significant supply bottlenecks. Clear out the vermin and restore access to a greater stockpile of iron.
quests.Name: Mine Sweep

quests.Description: The rugged inhabitants of Byrgenwald Forest would be a great addition to Yensburg's workforce. Send out emissaries to proselytize to them and convince them of their new purpose.
quests.Name: Wilderness Evangelism

quests.Description: Your enchanters have petitioned for a greater supply of Mercurial Flux. With it, they will be able to aid in the crafting of powerful Arcanite equipment. Unfortunately, this rare catalyst can only be found deep inside a claustrophobic cave network.
quests.Name: Mercurial Reagents

quests.Description: The brewing war in the East has displaced many people, driving them towards Yensburg while being chased by marauding orcs. Defend the fleeing refugees and make sure they are safe from harm.
quests.Name: Shield of the Innocent

quests.Description: Gangs of orcs and other marauders have occupied much of the farmland that surrounds Yensburg, enslaving the farmers and exporting the produce back to their homeland. Eradicate these squatters from your lands.
quests.Name: Farmstead Liberator

quests.Description: The Central Bank of Yensburg holds a vast number of gold and silver bars that technically belong to you, but withdrawing them would mean years of paperwork. Thankfully, there's an easier way of getting your hands on them.
quests.Name: Bank "Heist"

quests.Description: The vast woods south of Yensburg have never been fully safe, but recently even travel over the Imperial Road has been fraught with danger. Drive off the wild creatures that threaten passage through the forest.
quests.Name: Byrgenwald Expedition

quests.Description: For generations, the elementals of Midlake have lived in relatively harmony with the surrounding human settlements. Their recent unprovoked aggression calls for them to be culled once and for all.
quests.Name: Elemental Eradication

quests.Description: The cult that runs your Summoning Circle calls for help with some of their more obscure rituals. Specifically, they need a bodyguard to protect them in case the result of their summoning proves to be hard to control.
quests.Name: Experimental Summons

quests.Description: Spies in Yensburg have discovered a network of occult rituals being carried out in the dark places of the city. Send in someone with knowledge of the occult to put a stop to these blasphemous practices.
quests.Name: Extinguish the Ritual

quests.Description: As refugees were driven westward towards Yensburg, they ended up in a refugee camp that has been set up in the city's slums. Send in a team that has experience in dealing with the disease and misery that reign there.
quests.Name: Aiding the Refugees

dungeons.name: Ruins of Arlingen
dungeons.description: The remnants of an ancient treasure vault, repurposed into a high-security prison after the flow of valuables from the east dried up. \n\nScouting reports indicate that the surface is crawling with orcs, while the lower levels are controlled by the shambling remains of former inmates.

dungeons.name: Feral Den
dungeons.description: The vast network of caves known as the Feral Den lies deep beneath the roots of Byrgenwald Forest. Its wild denizens rarely interact with the surface world.\n\nRecent reports show that a strange corruption is seeping from deep within the cave, driving the beasts upwards towards the surface, driven mad with rage.

dungeons.name: Temple of the Last Rite
dungeons.description: Ages ago, a profane ritual was carried out here to imprison an ancient evil. Now, sinister forces are working to undo the ritual's magic.

dungeons.name: Yensburg Catacombs
dungeons.description: The labyrinthine tunnels beneath Yensburg Castle are still crawling with demonic entities. Send your adventurers down to clear them out and discover their origin.

dungeons.name: Timeless Archive
dungeons.description: An ancient lich lord has been building an archive of human history in this hidden mountain fortress for centuries. Break through the defenses, slay the mad Archivist, and recover powerful items to aid in your battle.

dungeons.name: Tomb of Sholrath
dungeons.description: Deep beneath the mountain, an ancient evil waits dreaming.

wars.name: Orcish Horde
wars.description: A brutish force that invaded Yensburg's territory from the east. Under their occupation, Yensburg is cut off from the fertile eastern lands, as well as the enormous fortress-city of Bastion.

wars.name: Southside Brigands
wars.description: A ragtag band of assorted criminals, brought together by a common cause: Plunder. They have occupied most of the ancient forest of Byrgenwald south of the city, cutting off contact with the forest dwellers and the port town of Yensmouth beyond.

wars.name: Ironcrag Siege
wars.description: A hidden army has struck at the heart of Yensburg, pouring from the catacombs below the city and establishing control over the wealthy northern districts.

wars.name: Siege of Yensburg
wars.description: A hidden army has struck at the heart of Yensburg, pouring from the catacombs below the city and establishing control over the wealthy northern districts.
